title: Local Llama vision
description: Follow an image and a question from a browser turn to a local multimodal model.
lesson: The original Chainlit app passes image paths to the SDK, waits for a complete answer, then replays characters. This version sends bounded base64 images through the REST API and displays tokens as they arrive.
experiment: Ask about one image, then repeat the question without the image in a fresh conversation. Compare supported visual details and first-token latency.
starter: Describe the main objects in the attached image. Separate what is visible from what you are inferring.
pitfall: Character-by-character display after a blocking model call is not provider streaming. Local deployment also needs image/context memory budgets.
